newsitem.title: USA: Acklands unit asks to convert to Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Acklands unit asks to convert to Chapter 11.

text.p: Rose Auto Stores said on Wednesday that it had asked for its involuntary motion for bankruptcy to be converted into a voluntary petition under the provisions of Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code.

Rose Auto added that it expects the petition, filed with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Florida, to be approved as filed, allowing the company to operate as a "debtor-in- possession."
"The long term prognosis for Rose Auto has not yet been determined," said John Grigsby, the newly appointed president and chief executive officer for Rose Auto.
"I am hopeful that Rose Auto will re-open some of its stores within the next few days," he added.
Rose Auto also announced that along with Grigsby's appointment as president and chief executive officer, it had appointed Harold Ferrell as vice president and chief operating officer.
Rose Auto Stores is a subsidiary of Acklands Ltd of Canada.
